name: Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)
description: Detects ISO 3779 Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs). VINs are 17-character alphanumeric codes that uniquely identify motor vehicles and can be linked to registered owners via DMV records. Characters I, O, and Q are excluded per the standard. Position 9 (check digit) is constrained to 0-9 or X.

metadata.format: 17-char alphanumeric, no I/O/Q, position 1 must be a letter, position 9 is check digit (0-9 or X)
metadata.note: ISO 3779 position-9 check-digit validation requires a dedicated validator not yet implemented; pattern alone filters most false positives. VINs are not PII directly but are linkable to registered owners via DMV.
